policy: Adaptive subagent concurrency for the adaptation program. Target is the number of agents kept running; on frequent rate limiting it steps down, and it recovers slowly when quiet.
step_down_on: 2 or more rate-limit agent deaths within one quota window
recover: +2 to target per hour with zero rate-limit events

events.note: The whole fleet died at once on the shared 5-hour pool, not on per-minute 429s. Concurrency does not cause this class of death -- total consumption does -- so the target is left where it is rather than stepped down again. Pool resets ~09:45 PDT; the 11:00 timer restarts the fleet after it.
